SELECT object_id,
                                s_info_windcode,
                                f_prt_enddate,
                                crncy_code,
                                s_info_bondwindcode,
                                f_prt_bdvalue,
                                f_prt_bdquantity,
                                f_prt_bdvaluetonav,
                                f_ann_date,
                                opdate,
                                opmode
							FROM ${srcdbname}.w_chinamutualfundbondportfolio t where  f_prt_enddate
                            between date_format(cast(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(cast(${end_date} as string),'yyyyMMdd')) as date)-interval 6 month ,'yyyyMMdd') and cast(${end_date} as string)
